automated.summary: mapping-master (mis-selection task 1): the versioned repo-owned Mapping Master is now the single runtime authority for selection and validation. It is a COMPILED TypeScript const (backend/src/mapping/mis-mapping-master.ts) rather than a runtime-parsed JSON file — the established runtime precedent (migrate.ts baseRolePerms, semanticLayer.ts baseDomains) — so it compiles into dist with zero runtime file IO; the grill caught that a ts-node-only JSON.parse under backend/src would pass every test and fail at app boot under `node dist/main.js`. Shape: ONE selection record (Agriculture / Nursery / plant_canonical DUB) owning the plant aliases (SAP 'DUB-NUR', display 'Agri - Nursery - DUB'), mis_format 'nursery-mis-financial-v1' and the GL-only budget_gl_codes coverage set (Budget has no SAP cost centre — mis_budget.cost_center is an informational Budget-Components label per 0016 — so the bucket mirrors onto Budget by GL alone); plus entry records mapping (cost_center, gl_code) -> mis_line, where each resolved triple's mis_line is Sheet1's 'Revised GL name' copied VERBATIM (human-decided: the only line-like label the source provides; Nursery MIS Format.xlsx is NOT a source because its format sheet is Table-1 Operational MIS, which the statement spec puts out of scope). The nine unresolved DUB triples get explicit entries targeting the reserved unmapped-GL line, each provisional with a reason — GLs 50001701-50001706 and 50001905 absent from Sheet1, and 50001902/50001903 recorded AS A CONFLICT (Sheet1 says Tertiary, SAP books Primary) rather than silently picking one of the workbook's two Cost Center columns. loadMappingMaster validates at module load and rejects a malformed master, a duplicate selection key, a plant alias reused across selections, a duplicate entry within a selection, and a provisional entry without a reason — the rejections that make 'exactly once / no fan-out' true. The module exports resolveMappingTriple as the ONE resolution path, which both canonicalPlantFromMaster and the gated proof call, so the proof cannot be circular. Ingestion's hard-coded PLANT_NORMALIZATION table now derives from the master, leaving exactly one alias authority. verify.py green; quality-gate green.
